description: Discover item-scoped query engines, direct endpoints and hosted MCP connections with their authentication audiences. No returned connection is followed.

discoveryWarnings: Connection metadata is not proof of authorization or availability; validate each selected destination/audience before connecting.

notes: Illustrative connection only, never executable placeholders. Discovery uses a storage-audience token. Engines and unknown response fields are preserved. Use each complete returned connection and its own audience; no skill is fetched or MCP session opened. A semantic-model discovery 404 can mean OneLake integration is unavailable, not that the Fabric item is absent.
